_info.description: RAiD application configuration file for local development. The app fetches it at runtime, so no rebuild is needed when values change. The CI end-to-end tests also use it.
_info.usage: Do not deploy this file. For an environment, copy app-config-examples/app-config.template.json and deploy it outside the build. See doc/UI/raid-agency-app/DEPLOYMENT.md.

sections.required: keycloak, apiBaseUrl, environment and supportEmail are required. The app does not start without them.
sections.local: Keycloak and the API point at the local stack (see CLAUDE.md). The services values are placeholders. To try the static-site lookups against a real environment, edit services.staticProd and services.staticBase on your machine and do not commit them.
sections.branding: This file has no theme, header or footer section, so the app shows its neutral RAiD look. Examples of agency branding are in app-config-examples/.

orcid.placeholder: Enter valid sandbox ORCID iD or ISNI
